parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the task as an exact Python-to-Node migration requiring pure ESM .mjs files, no external dependencies, exact argparse and output behavior, and delivery under /output.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It chose a two-track plan: the parent performed black-box probes and wrote foundational /output libraries while a workflow owned six broad extraction/specification tasks plus a second audit phase.
parallel.implementation: The parent produced partial support libraries for ranges, argparse, Python formatting, Unicode helpers, IDNA errors, and a punycode codec, but no executable entry file.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The workflow never returned an aggregate result and the final artifact contained only partial libraries; the required /output/test3.mjs entry was absent.
parallel.verification: There were many probe commands and isolated module checks, but no integrated Node implementation or evaluator-aligned end-to-end run before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The agent process timed out, the workflow was killed with null result, and the official completed evaluator scored the artifact 0/19 because the expected entry file was missing.

serial.requirements: The serial parent recognized the same pure Node ESM and exact behavior requirements from the prompt and read/probed the executable directly.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept all work in one actor, with no workflow or subagent delegation, and pursued local probing followed by local implementation.
serial.implementation: The serial run built probe scripts and created /output/lib/pyformat.mjs, but did not finish the IDNA implementation modules or the required entry file.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There was no multi-agent integration step; the final artifact contained only one helper library and omitted test3.mjs.
serial.verification: The serial run performed many black-box probes and generated/probed intermediate extraction scripts, but never ran a completed JS entry against the evaluator surface.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The process timed out and the official completed evaluator scored the artifact 0/19 because the expected entry file was missing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the exact ESM, .mjs, /output, no-dependency, black-box, and CLI/output parity obligations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial saw the same prompt and same required constraints, including exact argv behavior and the final test3.mjs entry.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement mismatch is evidenced; both understood the task but neither delivered the required entry file.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split the work into six broad workflow children for extraction/spec tasks plus audit while the parent wrote libraries.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflows and task tools disabled and kept the entire probe/build path in the parent process.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added a broad multi-agent extraction workflow; serial used a single-agent implementation path with no delegation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs shared a common task context and then assigned separate extraction/spec deliverables under /workspace/probe rather than direct final implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained the task context locally and used local probe helpers instead of handoffs or component contracts between agents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The key context difference was not a missing requirement in child briefs; it was that parallel converted context into broad research subtasks whose outputs never returned.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented several support libraries under /output/lib but did not finish the IDNA core or entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented only the Python-formatting helper in /output/lib and left the rest of the implementation unfinished.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced more partial library surface, but both implementation paths stopped before a runnable test3.mjs.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow result lifecycle ended with result null, killed status, and still-active child progress records.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; the parent process itself timed out without producing the entry artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a failed workflow result lifecycle in addition to the parent timeout, while serial had only a local unfinished run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote shared probe files and partial output libraries, but the final artifact had no assembled entry file and no proven write collision.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller single-agent artifact and likewise omitted the entry file without any shared-state boundary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more shared scratch and partial library state, but the concrete delivery failure in both runs was missing assembly of test3.mjs, not a proven file collision.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran numerous probes and some local checks but never had a completed implementation to verify end to end before official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also ran numerous probes and intermediate generation checks but never reached end-to-end verification of test3.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked final evaluator-aligned verification; parallel's workflow was still unfinished, while serial's local implementation was incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent the full process window with 12 workflow child logs, high workflow child token use, six live agents, and multiple stall retries.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also used the full process window but without workflow children, spending its budget on local probing and code generation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but parallel's distinctive budget pressure came from broad fan-out plus retries; serial's budget pressure was a long single-agent exploration.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both completed evaluations failed at 0/19. Parallel produced more partial library files, but its broad workflow was killed before returning usable extraction results and the final artifact still lacked test3.mjs. Serial avoided delegation but also spent the whole budget on local probing and partial generation, delivering only lib/pyformat.mjs and no test3.mjs.
